title: Foreground dev server in main agent flow
summary: Launching a long-running dev server in the primary conversation flow blocks progress and steals the control loop
remedy: Prefer help/build/probe commands; if a live server is truly needed, start it in background with explicit intent, log path, and shutdown ownership

title: Descriptor lazy-import did not slim deos chunk
summary: Moving the .papi/descriptors import behind a dynamic import inside web-client/src/lib/adapters/blockchain/deos.ts did not materially reduce the emitted deos client chunk; the descriptor barrel was already chunk-split, so this adds complexity without improving the hotspot.
remedy: Measure first, then target the real deos/bootstrap hotspot instead of adding async descriptor indirection

title: Premature micro-optimization before product need
summary: Do not add lazy-loading, bundle indirection, or similar performance complexity while the project is still raw unless tests, profiling, validation tooling, or real user/operator pain prove a concrete hotspot. Prefer business-facing delivery first and revert optimizations that do not produce meaningful wins.
remedy: Measure first, optimize second, and prioritize correctness, product flows, and contract honesty over speculative micro-optimizations

title: Direct pallet_xcm FRAME benchmark registration
summary: Adding pallet_xcm directly to runtime define_benchmarks with pallet_xcm::Pallet<Runtime> fails because that type does not implement FRAME Benchmarking in SDK 2603.
remedy: Register pallet_xcm benchmarks through pallet_xcm::benchmarking::Pallet::<Runtime> and implement pallet_xcm::benchmarking::Config for the runtime benchmark API.

title: FRAME provider does not bypass pallet-balances ED
summary: On Polkadot SDK 2606 pallet-balances v50, fungible can_deposit and transfer reject a new Balances account below ExistentialDeposit even when frame_system already holds a provider reference; provider-only preflight heuristics cannot make that transfer valid.
remedy: The DEOS runtime funds explicit free-ED anchors for native-flow topology accounts while generic Actors retains exact ledger consequences.

title: Reserved native balance does not bypass pallet-balances deposit consequence
summary: A runtime probe with an external FRAME provider, zero free balance, and a full ExistentialDeposit held in pallet-balances reserved balance still returns BelowMinimum through fungible can_deposit for a sub-ED free deposit; pallet-balances v50 compares new free balance directly with ED before considering reserved balance.
remedy: Use funded free-ED anchors at the runtime topology boundary; do not retry provider-only or reserved-only heuristics.

title: Rejected primary strategies for native sub-ED Actors ingress
summary: Upstream semantic changes, custom native accounting, and removal of the exact free-zero requirement were rejected as the primary DEOS strategy. Accumulation above ED remains only a possible future policy fallback, not the current transfer contract.
remedy: Fund one persistent free ED for admitted System Actors, custody, and staking-ingress accounts; preserve it through task resolution and consume only newly received conversion amounts.

title: Truncating sub-account derivation for generic custody
summary: Replacing hashed-seed AccountId decoding with PalletId::into_sub_account_truncating can collapse distinct tagged or owner-specific custody identities for narrow generic AccountId types.
remedy: Preserve canonical identities and remove decoding panics through explicit host-supplied custody accounts or a fallible API; validate narrow-AccountId mocks and concrete runtime addresses before retaining a derivation change.

title: Recursive PAPI generation during npm install
summary: Running papi generate from postinstall is self-recursive because descriptor generation invokes npm install; a clean CI host can retain incomplete descriptor types even when a warm local worktree passes.
remedy: Keep dependency installation free of descriptor generation; make clean validation prepare Svelte state, then generate descriptors exactly once before type checking.

title: Post-merge-only heavy validation
summary: A pull-request gate that runs only the fast profile can approve changes to client or heavy validation that first fail after merge on main, turning main into the discovery environment.
remedy: Run the heavy profile under the required pull-request validation-gate; retain main heavy and tag full as repeated evidence rather than first coverage.

title: Global request_activation deferral cannot implement NextBlock provenance
summary: Forcing every Idle request_activation under NextBlock to a block-N+1 wakeup produced 242 package test failures and changed temporal, direct-control, observation, queue-capacity, scheduler-meter, and continuation fixtures. request_activation is a shared placement owner, not a certified cause boundary; it cannot distinguish external causes from previously caused temporal or continuation service.
remedy: Carry typed cause provenance at occurrence materialization and preserve a separate prepass cutoff; do not infer cause timing from the generic activation owner or actor state.

title: Phase-only deferred-cause floor
summary: Applying N+1 from worker time whenever provenance is Deferred repeatedly postpones Observation fanout first processed after its source block and cannot distinguish already-aged work.
remedy: Persist the exact cause block with each latest/active dirty revision and Crossing transition; apply the floor only while service occurs in that source block.

title: W2 over-capacity sustained-Fresh geometry
summary: An EXP-0018 profile with 10,000 continuously Running Actors plus additional Fresh Actors exceeds the production MaxActiveActors=10,000 boundary and cannot represent an admitted workload.
remedy: Define 1,000/10,000 as total active populations partitioned between Running Actors and a bounded reusable Fresh-ingress pool; never exceed the configured active cap.

title: Maximum W2 setup through measured runtime blocks
summary: Constructing 6,656 Running and 3,329 Fresh Actors, then opening the Running set through ordinary runtime blocks, failed to finish by block 7,000 after 2,479 seconds with effectful Steps; replacing effects with skipped Steps still timed out after 3,600 seconds. This mixes population setup with the liveness interval and is not a bounded comparative harness.
remedy: Materialize a validated prebuilt Running/Fresh state artifact outside measured blocks, attest its storage/config identity, and measure only bounded post-snapshot ingress/service windows. Do not retain an hour-scale ignored unit test.

title: Average initialization ratio as fixed resource envelope
summary: FRAME's 10% average-initialization hint is not a conservative FixedBlockWeight bound; parachain validation registers dynamic inbound DMP/XCMP work and the runtime configures independent 25% reserves for each message class.
remedy: Derive and enforce a component-wise worst-case fixed/context envelope covering base/finalization, Timestamp, validation overhead, and both inbound-message reserves before configuring the schedulable budget.

title: No-std relay proof builder and incomplete static proof fixture
summary: cumulus-test-relay-sproof-builder advertises default-features=false but fails wasm32v1-none compilation because its source lacks no-std prelude/alloc imports. A generated static BasicParachainInherentData proof compiled, but benchmark dispatch trapped because the proof omitted the included parachain head required by set_validation_data.
remedy: Generate a complete static proof fixture containing included_para_head plus the exact DMP/HRMP MQC heads, validate it by dispatching set_validation_data in a std fixture test before embedding, then retry the Wasm benchmark; do not bind or retain a benchmark whose fixture has not passed the actual dispatch.

title: No-std relay proof builder and incomplete static proof fixture
summary: Resolved by generating the proof under std, validating the actual maximum set_validation_data dispatch, embedding only the 13,669-byte SCALE Basic fixture, and reconstructing message data in Wasm benchmark setup; benchmark completed at 50 steps and 20 repeats.
remedy: Do not depend on the broken no-std proof-builder path; keep the static fixture dispatch test as the falsification owner.

title: Prepass stale cleanup cannot reuse the current single-meter base pass
summary: Resolved by adding an independent scan-control meter bounded by the reserved Actor Control maximum; saturated prepass cleanup can now leave a stale suffix without letting subsequent FIFO scans consume ActorBase effect capacity or retain reservation authority.
remedy: Keep FIFO scan consumption dual-metered against both total pass capacity and Actor Control; do not substitute total-minus-effect reconciliation as the admission guard.

title: 100-Steps-per-block planning witness is incompatible with generated production Weight
summary: Complete branch-exact Actor control and effect Weight disproves the historical target of 10,000 one-Step cycles in 100 blocks; the accepted 10,000-Active-Actor scheduler requires a measured 1,300-block first-traversal horizon.
remedy: Use starvation-free first traversal under generated two-dimensional Weight as release evidence, report committed Steps and distinct Actors separately, and never present the 1,300-block evidence horizon as an SLA.

title: Regenerating proof-embedding artifacts for byte equality
summary: The PVF fixture export was regenerated and expected to match an earlier retained issue. Eight of ten files differed while every printed runtime invariant was identical, because sp-trie emits recorder-drained proof nodes in HashMap order and the reordered bytes propagate into the inherent, header extrinsics root and Aura seal. Rebuilding an artifact that embeds a drained storage proof cannot be expected to reproduce bytes.
scope: template/runtime fixture exports and exact-artifact pinning
remedy: Pin a retained artifact instance for downstream identity, or sort the drained proof nodes canonically before embedding them; never treat a fresh run as a regenerated pin.

title: File rewritten from a silently truncated read
summary: BACKLOG.md was rebuilt from a `read` result that stops at its own line or byte limit, so a 157 KB file was replaced by its first 25 KB. Every uncommitted edit past the cutoff was lost, including items created earlier in the same session, and the loss was unrecoverable because that text was never committed.
scope: context and knowledge-sync edits to a large tracked document
status: recovered from HEAD, session edits re-applied, uncommitted tail edits lost
remedy: Never feed a `read` result straight into `write`. Edit in place, read large files in bounded chunks, or recover the committed version from HEAD, and commit long-lived context edits early.

title: Regex block extraction spilling into the next type
summary: A struct/enum body extracted by matching the opening brace and then searching for a closing brace pattern returned concatenated fields from the following type, which produced 25 false ordering mismatches against generated metadata. The apparent mismatch was entirely an extractor artifact.
status: fixed by brace-matched body extraction, zero problems after the fix
remedy: Match braces from the opening brace instead of searching for a closing pattern, and treat a duplicated or reordered field list as an extractor artifact before reporting a contract mismatch.

title: Reinventing proof prerequisites after missing the canonical baseline owner
summary: Scoped Governance searches and compacted context were treated as evidence that no current key/schema/writer envelope existed, duplicating the integrity guard and ordinary TOP source owner and rediscovering already-covered enum-tag and Root cases. The same discovery failure can infer a late currency callback from a reconciliation call without checking the canonical hold delta and earlier AtTime rearm.
scope: Actors/Governance P0 source and evidence reuse
remedy: Search the whole repository for the semantic owner, characteristic constants and existing counterexamples before adding probes or backlog gates; bind current applicability by source identity and transfer only missing conditions instead of restarting inventories or retesting unchanged facts. Before adding a shared currency mock or expensive feature build, locate the actual mutating call and revalidation order; a named reconciliation helper need not invoke currency at that source.

title: Conditional Bash self-test swallowed a failing assertion
summary: A self-test function invoked with || return ran with errexit suppressed. Its Node argv assertion printed AssertionError, but subsequent successful commands returned exit0 and announced PASS, masking a wrong collector API prefix before any real collection.
status: corrected with explicit assertion/setup failure propagation and a contract-independent argv oracle
remedy: Do not rely on set -e inside functions invoked through if, !, && or ||. Explicitly propagate assertion and fixture-setup failures, and prove a known-bad input exits nonzero before trusting a green harness.

title: Rust identifier admission missed a reserved bulk selector
summary: The exact-name gate and a narrow source review missed that CLI literal all is a wildcard although it is a valid Rust identifier; --extrinsic all could bypass Actors owner quarantine. Valid fake generation reproduced status0 where refusal2 was required.
status: corrected with explicit Actors all refusal and generation/raw/merge regression cases
remedy: Validate selector semantics, not only lexical syntax. Check reserved bulk aliases against the owning CLI grammar and prove early refusal with valid fake routes, empty external-work traces and explicit assertion propagation.

title: Advancing a block argument did not age the consumed counter
summary: A benchmark moved block height to a configured threshold but left the scalar state one observation old; the helper ignored that block argument. Different Mock/reference thresholds therefore selected different event branches, while a positively named runtime test asserted only healthy absence.
scope: Benchmark branch reachability and host transfer
status: source limitation recorded; legacy owner remains quarantined
remedy: Trace the actual consumed state and transition inputs, compare host constants and read assertions rather than test names. Require lawful counter lineage and event context before selecting a new source witness; neither elapsed block labels nor a Mock PASS qualifies the reference branch or a physical upper.
